event.title: Free Your Android @ REUSE Köpenick in Berlin, Germany

body.p:
Has your smartphone manufacturer stopped providing updates?
But you still do not want to throw away your mobile or tablet?
Are you looking for cool apps that do not sell your data?
Does it bother you that Google is set to shut down its platform for third-party vendors, including learning programmers and others from 2027?
Would you rather use open and Freedom-Giving alternatives?
Together with our friends at REUSE Köpenick, we would like to show you how you can liberate your Android device.

That’s why we would like to invite you to our ‘Free Your Android’ evening.
Please do come along and bring your devices and any questions you may have.
Please register in advance.
https://reuse-koepenick.de/
The event will be held in German.
